title: StreamerUtils
description: StreamerUtils is a server‑side Fabric mod that enhances Minecraft chat for streamers and their communities.
body:
![A custom Minecraft title with the mod's name "StreamerUtils" and a split colour (dark_blue - grey) distribution between the words "Streaamer" and "Utils", featuring the mod's icon on the leftmost side.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/529895d205d8a771bf9c9ca4e6658dfe6da6b0e1.png)

**StreamerUtils** is a **server‑side Fabric mod** that supercharges chat and Twitch integration for streamers and their communities. It adds **custom nameplate icons, coloured usernames, live status, follow alerts, and interactive chat commands** – all configurable per player and saved across sessions.

# Showcase: 
> _(Those annoying advertisements plugins used to always shove in my face when I was hosting my friends' servers)_

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![A screenshot of Minecraft's in-game chat, showcasing an early developmental version of the mod's interactivity.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73bf236c10cf1c53713b5e887108df4b4c0e4d54.png)

</details>

---


Whether you run a streamer‑friendly server or just want a unique nametag, this mod gives you ( and your viewers) a more interactive experience. Viewers can use `!highlight` to make you glow, `!firework` to launch a rocket, and you get sound alerts for every new follower – all without any client mods (though a companion resource pack makes icons actually visible).

I plan to add more platform icons (Discord or whatever other random platforms you are interested in), but the current version is fully functional and stable already.

If you want to inspect the code or verify its safety, the source is available on [GitHub](https://github.com/codex-bat/StreamerUtils).
The mod currently packages [Twitch4J](https://modrinth.com/mod/twitch4j) with it too, which is actually the main reason it's around 17k KBs. I plan on adding it as a dependency instead, later.
 
Supports Minecraft **1.21.11** (other versions may work with updated mappings). Future updates will target 26.1/2 (or perhaps some requested versions, if ppl are interested) and add more features.

If you have any questions or suggestions, hit me up on [Discord](https://codexbat.dev/discord) (as usual)!

**IMPORTANT!** This project is in no way, shape or form, endorsed or sponsored by Twitch, Youtube, Kick or any other company which might be represented in this mod. Any icons included with this mod, or its resource pack, are purely for aesthetic, cosmetic purposes. Furthermore, the Twitch integration is simply using an open-source library as a dependency.

|| **Note:** This mod is open‑source under **GPL‑3.0‑or‑later**. Its use must comply with the license terms. It includes MIT‑licensed Twitch4J‑fabric and Apache 2.0 commons‑logging – full notices are inside the **JAR**. ||
